subject: Short-term QPS uplift & surcharge waiver for PlayForge launch
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@playforge.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:10:00Z
Subject: Request: short-term QPS uplift and surcharge waiver for PlayForge launch

Hi Rishi,

We're seeing a much larger-than-expected spike in traffic as we soft-launch PlayForge's new realtime match feed this morning. Our infra metrics show sustained QPS ~3x above our commit for the next 6–12 hours (sudden influx from partnership promo). Can Redwood provide a temporary QPS uplift and waive the normal overrun surcharge for the first 72 hours while we stabilize?

What we need:
- A provisional QPS increase from our committed 2k -> 6k for up to 72 hours
- Waiver or reduction of the standard 2x surcharge on overrun during that window
- A short-term true-up plan for any overrun that balances our customer experience and your billing needs

Attached: playforge-launch-spike.png (traffic graphs). Happy to hop on a quick call. We're motivated to keep this short and pragmatic — we can sign a short addendum/PO if necessary.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform, PlayForge
alex@playforge.ai

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Turner <alex@playforge.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: short-term QPS uplift and surcharge waiver for PlayForge launch

Alex — thanks for flagging and congrats on the launch momentum. Short answer: we can support a provisional uplift with guardrails. Proposed approach below; will need a signed addendum/PO to activate within 2 business days.

Proposal (72h provisional window):
- Temporary uplift: committed QPS -> 6k for 72 hours starting on approval time
- Surcharge: reduce the standard overrun surcharge from 2x to 1.25x for the first 48 hours; revert to 1.5x for hours 49–72 as a step-down (this limits upside while still covering capacity costs)
- True-up: blended discounted true-up rate for overrun volume attributable to the launch (we'll credit back 15% of overrun invoice as a launch incentive if combined monthly spend > $50k)

Next steps:
1) Sign short addendum (I attached a provisional-pricing-deck.pdf).
2) Send PO referencing deal PF-2026-12-01-TU1 and note the 72h uplift window.
3) We'll enable the uplift and monitor; we'll also keep your SRE in the loop for throttling thresholds.

If you want a faster path, I'm available for a 20-minute call now.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01T12:00:00Z
Subject: FW: Request: short-term QPS uplift and surcharge waiver for PlayForge launch

Monica / Ben — forwarding PlayForge's request. Quick summary and ask: they need a 72-hour provisional uplift to 6k QPS and are requesting waiver/reduction of overrun surcharge. My proposed structure: reduced surcharge (1.25x -> 1.5x step-down), blended true-up credit (15%) if monthly spend > $50k, PO required.

Questions for you:
- Monica: operationally can infra team provision a 6k soft cap with auto-revoke?
- Ben: can Sales/Finance approve the surcharge reduction + the 15% incentive tied to PO > $50k? If we need legal, flag Laura (cc'd if necessary).

I tried to keep the ask minimal and attach the pricing deck. Plan is to get a signed addendum + PO and then enable the window.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01T14:40:00Z
Subject: Re: FW: Request: short-term QPS uplift and surcharge waiver for PlayForge launch

Thanks Rishi — fine to approve the temporary uplift and the reduced surcharge for the 72h window, subject to:
- PO referencing PF-2026-12-01-TU1 received within 48 hours
- Minimum spend threshold clause added to the addendum (we can do $50k as you proposed)
- Billing will execute as usual; we'll apply the 15% credit post-invoice if threshold met

If Legal needs to tighten language around "launch-related" volume attribution, loop them in, but don't delay the customer — we can issue the addendum with a 7-day review clause.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Alex Turner <alex@playforge.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01T15:30:00Z
Subject: Approved: temporary uplift & staged surcharge — next steps

Alex — good news: we can enable the provisional uplift. Summary of terms and next steps below: 

Approved terms (72h provisional window):
- Uplift: committed QPS -> 6k for 72 hours once PO/addendum is countersigned
- Surcharge: 1.25x for first 48 hours; 1.5x for hours 49–72
- True-up: standard billing for overrun; apply 15% post-invoice credit if combined monthly spend > $50k and the overrun is attributable to the launch window

Action items for PlayForge:
1) Send PO referencing deal PF-2026-12-01-TU1 within 48 hours and sign the addendum (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF123456).
2) Share SRE contact for monitoring and a preferred rollback threshold (we'll default to 20% sustained error-rate/latency trigger).
3) We will provision the uplift within 4 hours of receiving the signed PO and notify your team.

Attached: provisional-pricing-deck.pdf (pricing summary + sample addendum). We'll apply the 15% credit after the overrun invoice is processed if you meet the threshold. If anything urgent, ring me at +1 (415) 555-0112.

Thanks and congrats on the launch traction — let's keep momentum and make this low-friction.

—Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
